work.title: Fantasia in D minor, K. 397/385g
work.status: single canonical work; fragment ending at bar 97

decisions.version: Fragment, no completion: ends with the minor section via an own transition, linked on the album to the Rondo in D major K. 485; recorded on two pianos.
Traditional completion: the ten closing bars from the 1806 Leipzig edition, attributed to August Eberhard Müller.

conclusion: Both recordings are performances of the same incomplete work (Mozart K. 397 fragment); no separate Works. Version annotation per recording as recorded above. Both remain outside the recommendations; no docs or Tidal playlist changes.
